messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a final call on the chat completions shape before the roadmap freeze. Customers keep asking about roles, system messages, and tool-calling compatibility. Do we standardize on `messages: [{role, content}]` or support `prompt` as first-class?
Sam: lean toward `messages` like other vendors — clearer for multi-turn, tool calling, and system role. keeps parity with customer expectations. :+1:
Priya: agreed but we need to define semantics: who can set `system` vs `assistant`? Also need to support structured output and function/json schema hints.
Alex: migration cost for existing prompt users is real. lots of internal SDKs + templates expect `prompt`. If we cut them off it's churn.
DevEx Bot: Related notes: https://go/research/chat-shape (internal) — previous proposals and customer asks summarized.
Maya: proposal: default canonical API accepts `messages` array. Add a compatibility layer that accepts `prompt` (string) and maps to `messages` for 6 months, with warnings. Validate roles strictly: allowed roles = ["system","user","assistant","tool"]. `assistant` cannot be provided by callers (only returned).
Sam: +1. Also: require `system` to be a message with role="system" rather than a separate top-level `system_message` field. Easier to reason about ordering and prefix caching.
Priya: For structured output (and tool calling) we should include an optional `instructions` top-level field for non-consuming hints to the model OR require n messages with role="system" for instructions. Which do we want?
Alex: I'd prefer a small top-level `meta.instructions` so we don't break customers who programmatically inject system text. But keep `messages` canonical.
Maya: tradeoffs: top-level instructions simplify some integrations but add dual places for rules -> confusion. Can we compromise: allow a top-level `instructions` as syntactic sugar, but on server-side it canonicalizes into `messages` (role=system) — docs should say it's sugar only.
Sam: That seems workable. What about partial updates & streaming? We need to preserve message indices so incremental token-level caching works. Implementation note: canonical `messages` must be ordered array, append-only semantics for stream context IDs.
Priya: Launch criteria we should track before GA: 1) SDK conversion helpers for Python/TS, 2) compatibility warnings logged for prompt users, 3) role validation + tests for tool calling edge cases, 4) perf benchmarks showing no tail-latency regression for `messages` migration.
Alex: Add: migration guide for customers with examples mapping `prompt` templates -> `messages` and CS playbook. Also add a short deprecation timeline (6 months) and a feature-flagged opt-in for strict role enforcement initially.
Maya: decision (tentative): adopt `messages` as canonical payload. Support `prompt` string input for 6 months with middleware mapping + warning header. Allow optional top-level `instructions` sugar that maps to a `system` message. Strict role set and server-side reject if a client attempts to send `assistant` as role (error 400).
Priya: Action items: Priya -> API spec PR (include examples for function calling + structured output), Sam -> SDK helpers + migration CLI, Alex -> customer comms + migration playbook, Maya -> finalize launch criteria and timeline.
Maya: Quick checklist for launch doc to include: 1) spec with examples, 2) SDK helpers and sample code, 3) migration blog + customer emails, 4) automated tests & perf reports, 5) deprecation schedule + header warnings.
Sam: I can prototype the Python helper this afternoon and share.
Alex: I'll draft an email template for customers on the prompt -> messages mapping and list affected templates.
DevEx Bot: Note added to roadmap board: /board/roadmap/CHAT-SHAPE-17685 (auto).
Maya: OK locking this as the product direction for the April release train unless any blocker pops up by EOD. Thanks all. :rocket:
